question: Can a small learned predecessor ranker reduce reverse search effort and inference-inclusive time at matched proof counts?

safety_contract.independent_witness_check: absolute-color array implementation of Othello rules

model_choices: one ReLU hidden layer with 16 units
training.epoch_selection: minimum ranking validation loss within each architecture
training.labels: observed predecessor versus unlabelled comparison; comparisons are never labelled unreachable
training.split_overlap_control: source-game separation and exclusion of validation groups sharing goal or candidate keys under start-preserving symmetries

search_validation.purpose: select one frozen model before final holdout
search_validation.selection: maximize proved reachable count of learned-beam then GBFS; among ties minimize median sum of independently timed stage searches; if the two times differ by at most 5 percent prefer the simpler linear model; unbounded learned search is not used for model selection

final_evaluation.historical: all 58 exact queries from research/beam_search/legacy_sat_positions.txt; historical UNKNOWN is not ground truth
final_evaluation.new_target_distribution: seed 20261128, 2000 exact population samples, existing necessary filters, placement-columns SAT at 1 second per goal and one concurrent goal; include every residual query
final_evaluation.model_comparison: evaluate both prespecified architectures as an ablation; actual CLI pipeline uses the validation-selected model; no model reselection from final results
final_evaluation.old_96_case_holdout: development/regression only, never the sole independent evaluation

interpretation: A lower node count or faster early termination with fewer proofs is not accepted as a matched-success improvement. A negative result will be retained. Learned exhaustion never supplies a negative reachability label.
